title: Church as it “Should Be” #1 | 1 Peter 3:8 | Pastor Tom Drion
description:
Beginning a new series in 1 Peter 3:8-12 entitled Church As It Should Be, Pastor Tom Drion examines Peter's call for believers to have "unity of mind" and what that should look like within the local church.

This sermon explores both the misuse and the biblical meaning of Christian unity. Distinguishing true unity from cult-like conformity, unquestioning loyalty to leaders, or rigid adherence to human traditions, Pastor Tom shows that Scripture calls believers to something deeper: a shared commitment to Christ, His gospel, and His people.

Drawing on examples from Acts and Philippians, the sermon highlights how unity flourishes where humility is present. Christians are called to strive side by side for the faith, putting aside selfish ambition, rivalry, and the desire for recognition. At the centre of Peter's instruction is brotherly love, expressed through compassion, tender-heartedness, and humble-mindedness.

title: The Forgotten War | Romans 8:12-13 | Pastor Adam Waller
description:
#spiritualbattle #christianwarfare 

Romans 8:12–13 presents the Christian life as a continual battle against the flesh. Drawing on biblical imagery of warfare, this message explores the reality that believers are engaged in a conflict not only against the world and the devil, but also against the sinful desires that remain within them.

The passage shows that this struggle is uniquely Christian, arising from the work of the Holy Spirit in those who belong to Christ. It explains why believers no longer owe allegiance to the flesh, how the Spirit provides the power needed to resist sin, and why the ongoing fight against sinful desires is evidence of genuine spiritual life. Along the way, the message addresses questions of assurance, discipleship, sanctification, and what it means to live as those who have been set free from sin’s dominion.

The call is clear: do not treat sin lightly or assume neutrality in the Christian life. Examine whether there is a real battle against the flesh within you, and by the Spirit put to death the sins that wage war against your soul while there is still time to respond in obedience to Christ.
